apps.name: Jellyfin
apps.description: Free software media system that puts you in control of managing and streaming your media.

apps.name: Immich
apps.description: Self-hosted photo and video backup with machine-learning search, albums, and mobile apps.

apps.name: AdGuard Home
apps.description: Network-wide ad and tracker blocking DNS server.

apps.name: qBittorrent
apps.description: Open-source BitTorrent client with a web UI.

apps.name: Nextcloud
apps.description: Self-hosted file sync, sharing, and collaboration platform.

apps.name: IT Tools
apps.description: Handy online tools for developers — JSON/YAML formatters, encoders, hash generators, regex tester, and more.

apps.name: Cloudflare DDNS
apps.description: Keeps a Cloudflare domain pointed at your home server's current IP — updates automatically after reboots or IP changes.

apps.name: Nginx Proxy Manager
apps.description: Reverse proxy with a web UI for managing domains, free Let's Encrypt SSL certificates, and access lists.

apps.name: MySpeed
apps.description: Runs automated internet speed tests and keeps up to 30 days of history.

apps.name: Jackett
apps.description: Translates search queries from apps like Sonarr/Radarr into indexer-specific requests — one API for dozens of trackers.

apps.name: Gotify
apps.description: A simple server for sending and receiving push notifications via a REST API and WebSocket — self-hosted alternative to Pushover.

apps.name: PHP + Nginx (multi-domain)
apps.description: Multi-domain PHP web hosting stack — separate Nginx and PHP-FPM containers, with almost every common PHP extension (gd, curl, mysqli, pdo_mysql, zip, intl, opcache, and more) preinstalled. Nginx's config folder is exposed as a volume, so you add one server block per domain and host as many sites as you want from one install.

apps.name: Vaultwarden
apps.description: Unofficial, lightweight self-hosted password manager server compatible with official Bitwarden clients — your own encrypted vault, no cloud subscription.

apps.name: Duplicati
apps.description: Encrypted, incremental backup client with a web UI — schedule backups of any folder to local storage, network shares, or cloud destinations.

apps.name: Sonarr
apps.description: TV series collection manager — tracks your shows, finds new episodes via Prowlarr/Jackett, and sends them to your download client automatically.

apps.name: Radarr
apps.description: Movie collection manager — tracks your movie wishlist, finds releases via Prowlarr/Jackett, and sends them to your download client automatically.

apps.name: Prowlarr
apps.description: Indexer manager for the *arr apps — configure your trackers once here, and Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr all share the same indexer list automatically.

apps.name: Lidarr
apps.description: Music collection manager — tracks artists and albums, finds releases via Prowlarr/Jackett, and sends them to your download client automatically.

apps.name: Plex
apps.description: Media server for movies, TV, and music — organizes your library and streams it to apps on phones, TVs, and browsers.

apps.name: Uptime Kuma
apps.description: Self-hosted uptime monitoring with a clean dashboard — pings your sites/services on a schedule and can notify you when something goes down.

apps.name: n8n
apps.description: Self-hosted workflow automation — a visual, node-based builder for connecting apps and APIs (like Zapier/Make, but self-hosted).

apps.name: FreshRSS
apps.description: A light, fast, self-hosted RSS/Atom feed reader with a clean web UI and multi-user support.

apps.name: Forgejo
apps.description: Self-hosted Git service — a community-driven, hard fork of Gitea. Host your own repositories, issues, pull requests, and CI actions.

apps.name: Firefly III
apps.description: Self-hosted personal finance manager — track income/expenses, budget, set financial goals, and see reports.

apps.name: BookStack
apps.description: Self-hosted wiki/documentation platform, organized as books, chapters, and pages.
